verdict: McDonald's revenue was flat at $6.4B as U.S. comparable sales slipped 1.4% on weaker guest counts, while franchised margins and cost discipline still nudged operating income up 2% to $2.9B.

segments.name: Franchised restaurants
segments.note: Rent and royalties paid by the local owners who run most McDonald's restaurants — the heart of the business model.

segments.name: Company-owned restaurants
segments.note: Food and drink sold at restaurants McDonald's runs itself.

segments.name: Other revenues
segments.note: Fees and other income beyond rent, royalties and restaurant sales.

segmentNote: Systemwide sales increased 2% (2% in constant currencies); comparable sales: U.S. -1.4%, International Operated Markets +0.1%, International Developmental Licensed Markets +4.1%. Loyalty members drove about $8B of the quarter's systemwide sales.

opex.name: Selling, general & administrative
opex.note: Head office, marketing support and running the global franchising machine — $800M of SG&A (including $136M of depreciation and amortization), plus $10M of other operating expense, net.

takeaways.title: Comparable sales barely grew
takeaways.text: Global comparable sales rose 0.4%: the U.S. fell 1.4% on fewer guests and a lower average check, International Operated Markets were nearly flat at +0.1%, and Developmental Licensed Markets grew 4.1%. Total revenue was flat at $6.4B.

takeaways.title: Loyalty is becoming the engine
takeaways.text: Systemwide sales topped $130B for the full year; loyalty members accounted for about $30B of that — roughly $8B in this quarter alone — across 60 loyalty markets, with more than 175 million 90-day active users.

takeaways.title: Profit held up on franchised margins
takeaways.text: Operating income rose 2% to $2.9B as higher franchised margins offset weaker company-owned restaurant margins, and EPS was flat at $2.80 ($2.83 excluding $18M of net charges).

oneTimers: Results included net pre-tax charges of $18M ($0.03 per share) — restructuring charges under the 'Accelerating the Organization' program and a write-off of impaired software no longer in use, partly offset by gains. Excluding them, EPS was $2.83.
otherDetail: Interest expense of $380M on McDonald's debt, partly offset by $49M of net nonoperating income.
footerNote: The release's rounded lines do not tie exactly: printed pre-tax income of $2,537M less the printed tax provision of $521M gives $2,016M, $1M below reported net income of $2,017M; the tax line here is $520M so the page ties to reported net income. The printed cost lines sum to $3,520M against a printed total of $3,519M; the component lines are followed here.
